Sedjem 0.2.0 transcribes YouTube videos and whole playlists, and plays a recording's video beside its
transcript.

## Download

- Windows 10 and 11: `Sedjem-0.2.0-setup.exe` installs for your user, without admin rights. It isn't
  signed yet, so SmartScreen warns about an unknown publisher: choose *More info*, then *Run anyway*.
  Installing over 0.1.0 keeps your transcriptions, keys and models.
- Linux (x64): unpack `Sedjem-0.2.0-linux-x64.tar.gz` and run `Sedjem/Sedjem`.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` has the checksums of both.

## YouTube videos and playlists

- On *New transcription*, choose *YouTube link* and paste the link of a video or a playlist. Sedjem shows
  its title, the number of videos, the total length and which videos have captions made by people, and
  lets you leave some out.
- Each video is downloaded at up to 720p and plays beside its transcript.
- When a video has captions written by people in its own language (Arabic or English), they become the
  transcript right away and no model runs. Otherwise the chosen model transcribes it. YouTube's automatic
  captions are never used.
- A playlist becomes a course: one entry in the sidebar with its progress, and on each lecture's page the
  YouTube link, the previous and next lectures, and a button that opens the course folder.
- Each course is saved in the `courses` folder of the app's data folder: a Markdown and an SRT file per
  lecture, numbered in playlist order, and `course.md` with every lecture in one file, ready to paste into
  an assistant for study notes. The files are updated when a transcript is edited.
- YouTube works best with a JavaScript runtime. If none is found, Settings offers to download Deno.

Downloading from YouTube is meant for personal use, under your own responsibility for YouTube's terms.

## Video beside the transcript

- Recordings with a picture (MP4, MKV, MOV, WebM, AVI and others) now play their video at the top of the
  side column, and the transcript follows it as it follows the audio. The video can be made larger, put in
  picture-in-picture or shown full screen.
- The video is prepared next to the transcription, so the transcript isn't delayed: copied as it is when
  the browser can play it, otherwise converted to H.264 at up to 720p.

## Fixes

- Settings no longer jumps back to the top every second and a half while a model downloads, and an API
  key being typed there is no longer erased (#7).
- The playback speed stays when another recording is opened.
- Running from source: PyAV is pinned below 19, which broke reading recordings for the Whisper models.

## Known limits

- A model has to be downloaded before starting, even for videos whose captions will be used.
- YouTube videos offered only in VP9 keep just their sound.
- A playlist is cut at 300 videos.
- The installer is unsigned, there are no automatic updates, and macOS isn't built.
